notes.title: No Time To Loot Festival
notes.notes: [p]Ahoy![/p][p]DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike is participating in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/humanqube/sale/notimetolootfestival2025"]No time to Loot Festival[/url]! So grab your balls and set sail and see what other loot filled games await you on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]For everyone joining us this week for the first time, please try out the demo for DWARRF and give feedback in the forms linked in-game. [/p][p][/p][p]As always, thank you for checking out my game,[/p][p]Sam[/p]
